actualEntryInspections.location: Actual adjective definition, including the ironic good-natured/naive or foolish use.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Corroborates the celebratory adjective and its ironic personal-description use. This is not the separate pregnancy/happy-event noun おめでた.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The observed adjective senses do not establish a standalone pregnancy noun or precise current frequency.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual noun definition listing happy events including marriage, pregnancy and birth.
actualEntryInspections.observation: The noun has the happy-event and pregnancy uses bundled into the community source gloss for adjective おめでたい. Preserve the raw gloss while distinguishing the two lexical identities.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The successful ID-less おめでた lookup redirected to this entry. The failed 御目出度 request is not evidence. Noun inclusion does not transfer its grammatical behavior to the adjective.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual entries describing an apologetic greeting to someone kept waiting.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Corroborates the wait-acknowledgment function. Differences between expression and 形動 dictionary classification are not treated as universal grammatical agreement.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The entries do not establish an absolute casual/polite/rude/obsolete ranking against お待たせしました.

actualEntryInspections.headword: おろす; separate wholesale おろす
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual broad lowering entry, cooking sense 8 with fish cutting and 8b grating marked 卸すとも書く; separate wholesale definition.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Corroborates wholesale selling to retailers and the cooking overlap with the broader lowering family. Grating and preparing fish are not exclusive spelling compartments.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Does not establish every source spelling's frequency or unrestricted substitution. Earlier Kotobank 卸す extraction contained unrelated PHP keyword material and was unusable, despite a redirect.

correctionActualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
correctionActualEntryInspections.location: Actual section [2], transitive godan/four-grade classification, grouping thinking of, hitting upon and remembering under a thought coming to mind.
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Corroborates the recognition-level recall sense as well as idea formation. The separate historical affectionate intransitive and lower-bigrade sections are not transferred into the modern lesson.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: Digital Daijisen rendered only a heading. The historical literary quotation is not a modern errand-recall example and does not prove present-day frequency or a categorical deliberate-versus-spontaneous rule.

correctionActualEntryInspections.source: 絵でわかる日本語, 2018-03-24 comparison lesson
correctionActualEntryInspections.location: Actual two prose sections: past/forgotten matters returning to memory versus a new thought or idea appearing.
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Supports practical production guidance to use 思い出す for ordinary recollection and 思いつく for an idea or proposal coming to mind.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: The teaching contrast is not an exhaustive denial of the dictionary's recall gloss. Embedded illustrations were not used as independently read examples.

correctionActualEntryInspections.source: 時雨の町, actual 2025-03-06 comparison article
correctionActualEntryInspections.headword: 「思い出す」、「思い付く」、「思い浮かぶ」、「思い浮かべる」的差別
correctionActualEntryInspections.location: Actual 思い出す section with the forgotten-person-name and yesterday's-dream examples, and separate idea/solution examples under 思い付く.
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Corroborates the known-name/past-event production contrast. The new article's short name-recall example is original wording following this ordinary pattern, not an attested rare 思い付く collocation.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: The summary-table extraction is incomplete; conclusions use the actual prose sections. Chinese translation labels do not override the complete Japanese dictionary record.

correctionActualEntryInspections.location: Actual headword variant also informal morning, greeting definition and Morning greeting example.
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: English morning can itself be a shortened greeting, supporting a context-free answer-label ambiguity with the existing 朝 and 午前 morning labels.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: This English ambiguity does not make Japanese 朝 or 午前 greetings, and does not establish app candidate probabilities.

correctionActualEntryInspections.location: Actual senses 1 and 2: early day and midnight-to-midday, with good morning cross-reference.
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Corroborates the morning labels' time-period interpretation alongside the separately inspected shortened greeting.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: The noun page alone is not the greeting definition; the good-morning entry supplies that evidence.

correctionAccessLimits: The Weblio 思いつく extraction lacked usable Daijisen or teaching-definition content; a Wiktionary cross-reference and dictionary-logo headings are not substantive verification.

An AI search synopsis claimed that no reputable source supports recall under 思いつく. The actually inspected pinned JMdict and Seisenban records contradict that categorical assertion; it was not accepted as evidence.
No suitable modern attested errand-recall example with 思いつく was established. Do not invent one to satisfy the literal review suggestion.
The supported correction supplies practical memory-production guidance and an ordinary 思い出す contrast without claiming recall is impossible under 思いつく.
English-label guards do not assert unrestricted Japanese interchangeability, identical argument structure, app execution or candidate likelihood.
